tools.name: helpjuice_search_articles
tools.description: Search the knowledge base by keyword, optionally inside one category. Returns article ids, names, short answer samples, categories and URLs. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/search.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_articles
tools.description: List articles, filtered by category, publish state, access level, language or update dates. Use it to find stale or unpublished content. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/articles.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_article
tools.description: Get one article by id, including its body, categories, publish state, views and author details. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/articles/{id}.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_categories
tools.description: List the knowledge base categories (the sections readers browse). Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/categories.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_category
tools.description: Get one category by id. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/categories/{id}.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the knowledge base, with their roles and groups. Filter by email, name or role. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/users.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with role and contact fields. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/users/{id}.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_groups
tools.description: List the user groups of the knowledge base. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/groups.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_group_users
tools.description: List the users in one group. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/groups/{id}/users.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_activities
tools.description: List the account activity log: who changed what and when. trackable_id and action_type need trackable_type. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/activities.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_account_settings
tools.description: Get the account name, subdomain, internal-KB flag and contact settings. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/settings/account.

tools.name: helpjuice_create_article
tools.description: Create an article in one or more categories. It is a draft unless published is true; published true makes it visible to readers at once. Helpjuice API: POST /api/v3/articles.

tools.name: helpjuice_update_article
tools.description: Change an article. Only the fields you pass change. Setting published changes what readers see. Keys whose role cannot publish save changes as drafts for review. Helpjuice API: PUT /api/v3/articles/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: helpjuice_search_articles, helpjuice_list_users · Private data: helpjuice_get_user, helpjuice_get_account_settings · Public sink: helpjuice_list_articles, helpjuice_get_article, helpjuice_list_users, helpjuice_create_article, helpjuice_update_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: helpjuice_search_articles, helpjuice_list_users · Private data: helpjuice_get_user, helpjuice_get_account_settings · Public sink: helpjuice_list_articles, helpjuice_get_article, helpjuice_list_users, helpjuice_create_article, helpjuice_update_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
